```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Information Management and Appointment Creation

  @VIRTUA-5-1
  Scenario: Admin updates doctor's information
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin updates the doctor's information
    Then the doctor's information is updated in the system

  @VIRTUA-5-2
  Scenario: Doctor's profile information is updated via admin
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin updates the doctor's profile information
    Then the doctor's profile information is successfully updated in the system

  @VIRTUA-5-3
  Scenario: Admin updates labs and chemists information
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin updates the labs and chemists information
    Then the labs and chemists information is updated in the system

  @VIRTUA-5-4
  Scenario: Lab/Chemist information is successfully updated via admin
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin updates the lab/chemist information
    Then the lab/chemist information is successfully updated in the system

  @VIRTUA-5-5
  Scenario: Patient updates their personal details
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient updates their personal details
    Then the patient's personal details are updated in the system

  @VIRTUA-5-6
  Scenario: Patient's details are successfully updated
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient updates their details
    Then the patient's details are successfully updated in the system

  @VIRTUA-5-7
  Scenario Outline: Patient creates an appointment to visit the doctor on a future date
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient creates an appointment for <appointment_date>
    Then the appointment is created and can be viewed in the appointments tab

    Examples:
      | appointment_date |
      | 2023-12-31       |  # Normal value
      | 2024-01-01       |  # Edge value (next year)
      | 2023-11-01       |  # Edge value (past month)
      | 2023-11-30       |  # Edge value (end of month)
      | 2023-02-28       |  # Edge value (end of February in non-leap year)
      | 2024-02-29       |  # Edge value (end of February in leap year)
      | 2023-11-32       |  # Invalid value (non-existent date)
      | 2023-04-31       |  # Invalid value (non-existent date)
      | 2023-02-30       |  # Invalid value (non-existent date)

  @VIRTUA-5-8
  Scenario: Appointment is created and can be viewed in appointments tab via Patient Appointment File
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient creates an appointment for 2023-12-31
    Then the appointment is created and can be viewed in the appointments tab
```
